question: What is the basic function of the internet?

options.A: Printing out patient care plans automatically
options.B: Generating electrical power for medical machines
options.C: Connecting computers globally to share information instantly
options.D: Storing physical files inside a hospital filing cabinet

explanation: The internet is a global network designed primarily to link computers together so data can travel freely between them. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T9#GNS113_U1_T9_h1)

question: How does the World Wide Web relate to the internet?

options.A: It is an older offline system replaced by the internet
options.B: It is a standalone computer used only by doctors
options.C: It is a specific service that displays web pages using the internet
options.D: It is the physical wire running underneath hospital floors

explanation: The web is just one part of the internet, acting as a collection of pages and sites viewed through a browser. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T9#GNS113_U1_T9_h1)

question: What are small pieces of digital data called when they travel across a network?
explanation: Data is broken down into small units known as packets so it can travel efficiently across computer networks. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T9#GNS113_U1_T9_h2)

question: Why does a hospital computer network use protocols like TCP/IP?

options.A: To make sure data packets reach the correct destination safely
options.B: To automatically print paper copies of every lab result
options.C: To prevent the monitor screen from dimming too quickly
options.D: To increase the physical storage size of the computer hard drive

explanation: Protocols are the established rules that guide how data is packaged, addressed, and successfully delivered across networks. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T9#GNS113_U1_T9_h2)

question: Which of the following is a well-known online database used by nurses to find research?
explanation: PubMed is a primary online database providing free access to biomedical and nursing research literature. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T9#GNS113_U1_T9_h3)

question: What is the purpose of using Boolean operators like AND in a literature search?

options.A: To automatically translate foreign medical terms into English
options.B: To print research articles directly to the nurse station
options.C: To combine keywords and narrow down search results
options.D: To check if a website is legally safe to browse

explanation: Boolean operators help structure search queries so you retrieve articles specifically relevant to your exact clinical question. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T9#GNS113_U1_T9_h3)

question: What does Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) allow nurses to do?

options.A: Print physical medication prescriptions automatically at home
options.B: Perform major surgical procedures over a live video stream
options.C: Replace all in-person nursing staff with computer software
options.D: Receive daily health readings sent from a patient's home device

explanation: RPM tools transmit vital signs and health metrics directly from the patient's home to healthcare providers for ongoing tracking. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T9#GNS113_U1_T9_h4)

question: A patient living in a rural village needs regular blood pressure checks but cannot travel easily to the clinic. Which internet-based service is best suited for this situation?
explanation: Telehealth bridges geographical gaps, allowing continuous care and observation for patients far away from the main hospital. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T9#GNS113_U1_T9_h4)

question: What is a major risk of patients using unverified health websites?

options.A: Their internet connection will permanently stop working
options.B: The hospital will charge extra fees for internet browsing
options.C: They may encounter dangerous misinformation or fake remedies
options.D: Their computer will automatically delete all personal photos

explanation: Unverified sites often lack medical review, leading patients to trust inaccurate or harmful health advice. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T9#GNS113_U1_T9_h5)

question: Why is checking the publication date important when reading health articles online?

options.A: Older articles require special passwords to open them
options.B: Websites automatically delete articles after exactly one year
options.C: Older web pages take up too much space on computer screens
options.D: Medical guidelines and treatment practices change as new research emerges

explanation: Healthcare is fast-moving, and outdated information can lead to unsafe clinical practices or incorrect patient education. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T9#GNS113_U1_T9_h5)

question: What is the primary action a nurse should take when stepping away from a computer terminal on the ward?

options.A: Leave the charting page open for quick access
options.B: Unplug the internet router from the wall
options.D: Turn off the main hospital power

explanation: Locking your workstation prevents unauthorized people from viewing or altering confidential patient records while you are away. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T9#GNS113_U1_T9_h6)

question: Which of the following practices represents a serious breach of patient data security?

options.A: Logging out of the electronic health record system after finishing a shift
options.B: Using a secure hospital database to check current medication guidelines
options.C: Posting a patient's clinical case details and photo on a personal social media page
options.D: Asking an IT technician for help fixing a broken network cable

explanation: Sharing identifiable patient information online violates patient privacy laws and breaches professional ethical standards. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T9#GNS113_U1_T9_h6)

question: Why is accepting a patient's friend request on personal social media discouraged for nurses?

options.A: It automatically shares the nurse's bank account details with the patient
options.B: It slows down the hospital's internet connection speed
options.C: It blurs the boundary between a professional relationship and a personal one
options.D: It violates copyright laws regarding medical textbooks

explanation: Maintaining clear professional boundaries is essential for safe nursing practice and protects both the nurse and the patient. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T9#GNS113_U1_T9_h7)

question: A nurse sees a public social media post from someone asking for medical advice about an open wound. What is the safest and most professional action?

options.A: Write a detailed treatment plan in the public comments section
options.B: Refrain from giving specific personal diagnoses and suggest they visit a clinic
options.C: Ignore the post and share pictures of the ward to cheer them up
options.D: Share the hospital's internal secure password with the commenter

explanation: Giving casual medical advice online creates legal liability and fails to provide safe, formal clinical assessment. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T9#GNS113_U1_T9_h7)
